text:
A

Response A is accurate and complete, covering the price and data changes, who is affected, the options, the reason and the support details. Its word count is borderline. A plain whitespace count gives about 123, but about 117 if the arrows aren't counted, so it may be a few words over the 120 limit.

Response B is under the limit, at about 113 words. But it has a factual error. It says "Classic plan customers and those on fixed-price contracts are unaffected until their contract ends." The notice says Classic customers are unchanged "this year" and that only fixed-contract customers wait until their contract ends. B also omits the support details.

B's error could mislead a manager, and A's overrun is marginal and arguable, so A is better.
